notes.title: Our fav Hidden Through Time streams since launch
notes.content:
Well hello time-travellers! 

It’s hard to believe it’s already been a few months since we launched Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery! We’re beyond grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown—not just for this game but for our previous titles in the series too.

Thanks to this amazing community, the game has racked up some wonderful community streams and videos online. We’re thrilled to see so many of you exploring the game and sharing your adventures. A massive thank you to everyone playing, streaming, building and creating content!

This short blog is a token of appreciation for all of you who have played and/or streamed in recent weeks. Here are some of our favorites:

Of course, five clips aren't nearly enough to express the breadth of incredible streams and let’s plays you guys have created since the very first in the Hidden Through Time series. You've been with us through every step of this journey, and it's because of your passion, feedback, and dedication, that we've been able to grow and push the boundaries of what we create. 

Thank you for being such an amazing community—we can't wait to continue this adventure together!

Don’t forget to support your indie creators by subscribing and watching their content!

- Alika

notes.title: Join Us at Steam NextFest: June 10 - 17!
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce that [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i] will be participating in the upcoming Steam NextFest, running from June 10 to June 17! This is a fantastic opportunity for you to get a first-hand look at our latest game and experience the magic we’ve been crafting.

[h2]Play the Demo[/h2]
During Steam NextFest, you can play the demo of [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i]. Immerse yourself in the richly detailed eras we’ve created, from the elegant Victorian age to the futuristic Sci-Fi world and the mysterious Noir setting. Discover hidden objects, solve intricate puzzles, and get a taste of the adventure that awaits!

[h2]Wishlist Now![/h2]
Enjoying the demo? Don't forget to wishlist [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i] on Steam! Wishlisting not only keeps you updated with all our latest news and release dates, but it also helps support our game’s development.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094680/Hidden_Through_Time_2_Discovery/

We can't wait for you to explore the captivating worlds we’ve created and hear your feedback. Your support and enthusiasm mean the world to us.

Stay tuned for more updates and see you at Steam NextFest!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: A First Look At The Three Eras!
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

We’re excited to bring you a first look at the new eras you’ll be exploring in [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i]. Our team has worked tirelessly to create richly detailed and immersive environments that will transport you across time and space. In this update, we’ll dive into the Victorian era, a futuristic Sci-Fi world, and the mysterious Noire setting. Let’s embark on this journey through history and beyond!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/2b3ba5533532c5d286d6191275b568918c3796c3.png[/img]
[h3]The Age of Innovation and Elegance[/h3]
Step back into the Victorian era, a time of elegance, innovation, and a hint of mystery. In this era, you'll find yourself amidst grandiose architecture, lavishly decorated rooms, and the hustle and bustle of 19th-century city life. As you navigate through intricately designed scenes, keep an eye out for hidden objects that capture the essence of this historical period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/f411ae2b6aca201534bc920f50b422a4fb137a7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/18206c5551745191e756ffbfb462c9dc1710cf60.png[/img]
[h3]A Glimpse into the Future[/h3]
Blast off to the Sci-Fi era, where the future is bright, bold, and full of technological marvels. This era invites you to explore futuristic cities, advanced spaceships, and alien landscapes. The vibrant, imaginative settings are a playground for those who love to discover hidden objects in the most unexpected places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/d59cb8a7e3d38cfd6e571725424d505576735cd5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/4ee0a862be085ab3a581ca8b3220f5faa611ca9e.png[/img]
[h3]Mystery and Intrigue[/h3]
Transport yourself to the Noir era, where the world is painted in shades of grey, and every corner hides a secret. Inspired by the classic film noir genre, this era brings a gritty, suspenseful atmosphere to your hidden object adventure. The dimly lit streets, smoky jazz clubs, and shadowy alleys are filled with clues waiting to be discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/3fc5456ca85fdce9c14dd4eaacfc26b1b35fe6f1.png[/img]
Creating these diverse and immersive eras has been a labor of love for our team. Each setting offers unique gameplay experiences and challenges, ensuring that [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i] provides something for every player. Whether you’re solving a mystery in the rain-soaked streets of a Noire city, exploring the technological wonders of a Sci-Fi future, or marveling at the innovations of the Victorian age, we hope you’ll find each era as captivating and engaging as we do.

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through time and imagination!

notes.title: Board the spaceship to Discovery!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce we are expanding the Hidden Through Time franchise with the next installment; [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/b]!

[previewyoutube=RdL6dcTADFw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is coming soon to PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Mobile (Android, iOS).

Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is a cozy hidden object game that has you searching for hidden objects in hand-drawn, interactive landscapes. Ignite your imagination, unleash your inner artist with the editor and share your masterpieces with the world!

[h2]Key features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Relaxing Gameplay[/b]
A relaxing and cozy experience is ensured as the game doesn’t feature timers or similar mechanics to put pressure on the player. They’re able to enjoy the game at their own speed.

[*] [b]Map Editor[/b]
Players have access to assets from all three eras (Noir, Victorian, and Sci-Fi), giving the ability to bring their imagination to life in the Map Editor, where creations can be shared with the community.

[*] [b]Reality shift[/b]
Seen in the previous game, Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic, the Reality Shift feature makes a return. This allows players to explore a whole host of new objects as they can shift between time and season, giving more depth to each map, enabling more space for storytelling within one map. 
[/list]
